question.text: The annualized forward premium for a 3-month USDINR contract is 4%. If the spot rate is 84.00, what is the approximate 3-month forward rate?

explanation.text: The Logic: Using the IRP/forward-premium relation, prorate the annualised premium to the contract tenor: 3-month premium = 4% x (3/12) = 1%. Forward rate = Spot x (1 + period premium) = 84.00 x 1.01 = 84.84. The Trap: Option B (87.36) applies the full 4% annual premium to spot, which would be the 12-month forward, not the 3-month forward. Option C (84.00) ignores any premium. Option D (85.68) uses double the correct 3-month premium (2%). Note: Distributor-style and test-frequency wording removed; explanation tied to the IRP/forward-premium formula with annual-period proration.
